title: Completion fibres survive coefficient quotient
statement: Let S be a Noetherian commutative ring, Q a maximal ideal of S[X], and s a prime ideal of T=S[X]_Q. Let R be the contraction of s to S[X] and p its coefficient contraction to S. Put f:S[X]→(S/p)[X] for the coefficient quotient map, q=f(Q), and r=f(R), with q maximal and r prime. There exist a residue field ring equivalence σ:κ(r)≃κ(s) and a ring equivalence e:κ(r)⊗[(S/p)[X]]((S/p)[X]_q)^∧ ≃ κ(s)⊗[T]T^∧ such that e(x•a)=σ(x)•e(a). All completions are at the respective local maximal ideals.

source.place: Proof of Proposition 07PV, paragraph 2; proof of Lemma 07PN

proof.text: The coefficient map f is surjective, and Polynomial.ker_mapRingHom identifies its kernel with pS[X]. The contraction hypothesis puts this kernel inside P = s ∩ S[X], which lies inside Q because denominators outside Q are units. Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective gives P = f⁻¹(r) and Q = f⁻¹(q).

Use Ideal.ResidueField.mapₐ and RingHom.SurjectiveOnStalks.residueFieldMap_bijective for f and for S[X] → S[X]_Q. Compose the inverse quotient comparison with the localization comparison to obtain the canonical S[X]-algebra equivalence σR : κ(r) ≃ κ(s).
Apply AdicCompletion.nonempty_surjective_baseChange to identify the quotient-polynomial localization completion as (S/p)[X] ⊗[S[X]] Cp, as an algebra over (S/p)[X].

Tensor this equivalence with κ(r) and use Algebra.TensorProduct.cancelBaseChange. Transport the residue-field factor along σR, then use IsLocalization.tensorProduct_compatibleSMul and Algebra.TensorProduct.equivOfCompatibleSMul to change the base from S[X] to S[X]_Q. The composite is a κ(r)-algebra equivalence when κ(r) acts on κ(s) via σR; its linear map preserves scalars, proving the original compatibility equation.

proof_origin.place: Tags 07PV and 07PN, using the proved completion base-change lemma and Mathlib residue-field/tensor equivalences

theorem exists_quotient_completion_fibre_iso
    (S : Type u) [CommRing S] [IsNoetherianRing S]
    (Q : Ideal (Polynomial S)) [Q.IsMaximal]
    (s : Ideal (Localization.AtPrime Q)) [s.IsPrime]
    (p : Ideal S)
    (hp : p = (s.comap (algebraMap (Polynomial S) (Localization.AtPrime Q))).comap
      (Polynomial.C : S →+* Polynomial S))
    (q r : Ideal (Polynomial (S ⧸ p))) [q.IsMaximal] [r.IsPrime]
    (hq : q = Q.map (Polynomial.mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk p)))
    (hr : r = (s.comap (algebraMap (Polynomial S) (Localization.AtPrime Q))).map
      (Polynomial.mapRingHom (Ideal.Quotient.mk p))) :
    ∃ σ : r.ResidueField ≃+* s.ResidueField,
      ∃ e : r.Fiber (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q))
          (Localization.AtPrime q)) ≃+*
        s.Fiber (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime Q))
          (Localization.AtPrime Q)),
        ∀ x a, e (x • a) = σ x • e a
